beats.text: Polly lies sprawled across Pax on the sofa and hugs him, pressing her face to his cheek
Polly kisses Pax's cheek with her eyes shut as little hearts float up above them while Pax squeezes his eyes shut

Polly draws back from Pax's cheek, smiling with her eyes squeezed shut, while Pax blinks
Polly lifts her head, looks at Pax and tugs at the edge of the blanket
Polly slips down under the blanket beside Pax
Polly snuggles under the blanket next to Pax with rosy cheeks and closed eyes while he looks on
Pax blushes and shuts his eyes too while Polly stays snuggled against him under the blanket
